title: sapium biglandulosum var. aucuparium
intro: Sapium biglandulosum var. aucuparium, commonly known as the Indian frankincense or Indian copal tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. The extracts and resin of this plant have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, helping to reduce pain and inflammation, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Sapium biglandulosum var. aucuparium include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, antimicrobial, and analgesic effects, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as skin infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
